eval.description: Google DeepMind internal automated image-to-text content-safety eval against Gemini safety policies. Cards report violation-rate deltas versus a prior Gemini (lower is better). Lab-internal dataset and runner.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model writes unsafe text that breaks safety policies when given an image.

versions.changes: Google DeepMind updates query sets and automated graders; card deltas are not always comparable across releases.

scores.description: Whether the response to an image-plus-text prompt violates a safety policy.

metrics.description: Share of image-to-text prompts whose responses are graded as policy violations. Lower is better.
